jobs.description:
Location

New York, New York

Shift

Day Flex (United States of America)

Description

Experience a Mission-Driven Career

Ranked as one of the top ranked New York hospital by U.S. News & World Report, NewYork-Presbyterian (NYP) has a long tradition of bringing hope, health and healing to our communities. NYP’s commitment to addressing the specific needs of its local communities shines brightly through the work of its Ambulatory Care Network (ACN) and Division of Community and Population Health (DCPH). The ACN and DCPH is comprised of 14 primary care sites, seven school-based health centers, 13 mental health school-based programs, and over 60 specialty practices. It also oversees over 20 community programs, including a NYS Health Home Program. The Comprehensive Health Program (CHP), the site of this position, is a center of excellence for HIV treatment and prevention as well as sexually transmitted infections and general infectious diseases. To address social determinants of health and mitigate risk for poor outcomes among vulnerable populations, CHP has embraced comprehensive care coordination strategies and practices multidisciplinary, team-based care including integrated behavioral health services, intense care coordination and primary care. Patients are cared for by a team of multidisciplinary providers (care coordinators, SW, RN and primary care provider) and are offered Health Home enrolment as part of this comprehensive care. NYS’ Health Home programs are designed to address complex and high-cost medical conditions and to address medical, behavioral and social needs comprehensively. Care teams work collaboratively to develop patient-centered care plans that empower patients to be an active participant in his/her health care.

Program Manager – Comprehensive Health/Health Home & Care Coordination - Grant Funded

We seek a program manager to oversee our care coordination programming and Health Home program activities. The Program Manager will lead the care coordination and Health Home programs along with other Program Managers, overseeing all day-to-day operations and monitoring all program requirements (billing, documentation, data reports). The Program Manager will guide implementation of the strategic vision of the program in order to ensure its sustainability and longevity. The Program Manager will collaborate with team members and specifically will oversee all team care coordinators by providing supervision, coaching, guidance and feedback towards the shared aim and vision. The ideal candidate will need strong organizational skills and be able to interpret and apply findings from data reports to ensure high fidelity of data for programmatic requirements, documentation and billing. Additionally, the Program Manager ideally would have familiarity with Grant Funded program implementation, evaluation, and management as the Program Manager will participate with the team to help continue implementation and enhancement of existing grant funded programming which the care coordination staff participate in. At the same time it is crucial for the Program Manager to be able to effectively supervise care coordinators and possess an excellent ability to communicate verbally and through writing. Case management and/or Behavioral Health experience will allow the Program Manager to guide care coordinators to resolve clinical and administrative challenges. Program Managers will participate in the program’s Care Coordination Steering committee meetings and collaborate on future directions of the program. Relationship building and networking skills are crucial to this role, as the Program Manager will collaborate with many NYP departments and community organizations to ensure the ongoing success of the program and increase its internal and external visibility. The Program Manager will closely track program outcomes to routinely report back to various groups, including funders, senior leadership, and other stakeholders.

Preferred Criteria

Bilingual English/Spanish
Master’s in social work/related clinical field or Master’s in Public Health
Experience in program management, development, implementation and evaluation
Interest in Quality Improvement strategies/planning
Familiarity with care coordination and program management including ensuring deliverables are met and reporting out to key stakeholders.
Comfort with data reports and tasking team members to achieve high quality outcomes for patients and meet programmatic requirements.

Required Criteria

Bachelor's Degree
Minimum of 5 years of experience
Minimum of 2 years supervisory experience
Strong written and oral communication skills
Experience in program development, implementation and evaluation

Join a healthcare system where employee engagement is at an all-time high. Here we foster a culture of respect, belonging, and inclusion. Enjoy comprehensive and competitive benefits that support you and your family in every aspect of life. Start your life-changing journey today.

Please note that all roles require on-site presence (variable by role). Therefore, all employees should live within a commutable distance to NYP.

NYP will not reimburse for travel expenses.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
The Company

We believe general-purpose, generally-intelligent robots will be built in our lifetimes. Robots will work in our factories, move our goods, walk on our streets and eventually be in our homes. To build that future, research and deployment must work in lockstep: real-world operation must make the technology better and better technology must make deployment easier. We're looking for the thinkers, builders, and researchers who want to be part of that loop.

As an AI robotics company that deploys its inventions directly into the facilities that need them, on state-of-the-art hardware, every line of code written at Tutor has a direct impact on the global, physical economy.

Our Culture

We believe that something truly special can happen when talented, motivated people work together; at Tutor, every member of our team is empowered to have real impact in everything that they do. We’re characterized by both technical excellence and next-level collaboration and respect.

The Role

Tutor is hiring a Senior Technical Program Manager to own program management for the Cassie workstream. Cassie is our robot worker for pallets and cases: we have many Cassie robots are in production at customer sites today and the next products built on the same platform are in development now. The workstream is about 15-20 engineers across software and hardware. This role will report to an engineering manager.

We’re looking for a candidate who has run programs long enough to know which parts of the job are not the interesting part - and has ideas for how to automate it. Chasing status, reconciling three trackers that disagree, tracking dependencies - all need to get done, but ideally not by a person. We’re looking for someone who has watched AI tools get good enough to do some of that grunt work and has a vision for how a program should run with automation, updating as tools increase in efficacy. We want the person who will build that automation while operating the program.

Tutor builds robot workers and deploys them directly into the factories and warehouses that need them. The Cassie workstream's output is measured in robots that keep running on a customer's line and in new products that reach production on schedule. That means one team carries a fleet in production and a platform in development at the same time, with software, hardware, manufacturing, deployment, and customer teams all collaborating. This role will own the integrated plan, the operating cadence, the risks, the cross-team dependencies, and the honest weekly picture of where things stand.

What You Will Do

jobs.title: Application Security Analyst
jobs.description:
A Fortune 500® company, EMCOR Group, Inc. (NYSE: EME) is a leader in mechanical and electrical construction, industrial and energy infrastructure, and building services. EMCOR companies plan, install, operate, maintain, and protect the sophisticated and dynamic systems that create facility environments—such as electrical, mechanical, lighting, air conditioning, heating, security, fire protection, and power generation systems—in virtually every sector of the economy and for a diverse range of businesses, organizations, and government.

Job Summary

EMCOR Group, Inc. seeks an Application Security Analyst who would support EMCOR’s Security Program with a primary focus of integrating AppSec tools into CI/CD pipelines, managing application security vulnerabilities and partnering with development teams to prioritize security in their practices. This role plays a key part in maturing our DevSecOps culture, reducing EMCOR’s overall attack surface and strengthening the EMCOR Information Security Program.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Support and monitor the enterprise information security system as directed by management.
Manage daily operations and support for Application Security products, including incident and ticket resolution.
Provide expertise during incidents, document findings and help improve protocols.
Maintain and upgrade application security related platforms.
Tune application security related policies and rulesets.
Collaborate with business and IT partners to integrate security tools (SAST, DAST, etc.) and platforms into CI/CD pipelines and workloads.
Contribute to and perform security reviews of Terraform configurations and reusable modules supporting EMCOR’s Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
Validate Terraform changes for security, compliance and alignment with established cloud architecture standards.
Monitor code platforms and resources for security threats, investigate and respond to security incidents and findings.
Write SIEM queries and perform analysis of results.
Respond to security tool findings and collaborate with business and IT partners for remediation.
Implement, configure, manage and support Web Application Firewalls (WAFs), including the tuning of rulesets and policies.
Contribute to various application security related projects and initiatives.
Perform special projects as needed.

Qualifications

3+ years of hands-on experience in an Application Security, Product Security, DevOps or DevSecOps role.
Experience working in cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI).
Experience with CI/CD and developer workflow automation such as GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines.
Experience developing or reviewing Terraform used to deploy Azure infrastructure, including reusable modules.
Experience managing and tuning Web Application Firewall (WAF) policies, specifically for Azure Front Door.
Experience triaging and remediating vulnerabilities identified by GitHub Advanced Security (GHAS) or Microsoft Defender for Cloud platforms, including CodeQL, Secret Scanning and Dependency Review.
Demonstrated proficiency in using PowerShell for administration and automation purposes.
Proven ability to communicate effectively and interact professionally at all organization levels.
Strong project management capabilities.
Ability to consistently deliver an exceptional standard of customer service.

Accountability and Measurement

Support and maintain EMCOR’s Security Program.

jobs.description:
Mission Overview

About the job Business Project Manager ICT Security Compliance

Keystone Solutions is seeking a Business Project Manager for a consultancy mission at a client site. This role focuses on supporting the implementation of the European NIS2 directive, aimed at enhancing the cybersecurity resilience of essential organizations within the EU. The successful candidate will work closely with the business responsible and expert for NIS2, coordinating organizational and substantive aspects of two key projects.

Key Responsibilities

Organizational Support & Business Impact: Support the business responsible for NIS2 in translating technical requirements into organizational measures. Analyze and describe the impact of the two projects on involved business domains, processes, and stakeholders. Facilitate workshops and working sessions with internal stakeholders (ICT, business, data owners, CISO function). Contribute to change management and communication towards involved services.
Project Coordination & Monitoring: Monitor project planning, milestones, and deliverables for Asset Management and Data & Platform Security. Prepare and maintain project sheets, status reports, and progress overviews. Organize and follow up on steering groups, working groups, and review moments. Identify risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks and escalate as necessary. Maintain a structured project file (decisions, actions, documentation).
Description of Processes, Policies & Procedures: Map and describe current and desired processes regarding asset management and data & platform management. Contribute to the drafting and validation of policies and procedures in accordance with NIS2 / CyFun requirements. Assist in the creation of work instructions, process descriptions, and governance documentation. Ensure alignment between technical measures and organizational procedures.
Reporting & Communication: Prepare clear management reports and progress reports for the program manager and management. Ensure a consistent and correct documentation flow within the program. Contribute to the preparation of steering group materials and audit requirements (CCB, NIS2 supervision).

Collaboration & Positioning

The NIS2 Implementation Analyst / Project Coordinator will work closely with:

Program Manager NIS2: Reporting, prioritization, and program alignment

Business Responsible / Expert NIS2: Direct support; substantive steering of the projects

ICT Security Team: Technical input, validation of measures

Business data owners & process owners: Establishing scope, impact, and requirements

External security supplier (Proximus / Smals): Coordination of SecaaS 2 / IAP+ implementations.

Required Knowledge & Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Business Administration, Public Administration, or equivalent through relevant experience.
At least 4 years of demonstrable experience in project coordination or management within an IT or security context.
At least 3 years of experience in describing processes, drafting policies, and procedures in a regulated environment.
Knowledge of the CyFun framework (CCB) and/or related frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls).
At least 3 years of experience in stakeholder management and facilitating multidisciplinary working groups.

Assets

Experience within a federal public service or similar public organization.

Experience with NIS2 implementation projects or previous involvement in cybersecurity programs.

Certifications such as PMP, Prince2, CISM, or ISO 27001 Foundation/Lead Implementer.

Familiarity with asset management tools or CMDB concepts (for the IDENTIFY project).

Knowledge of platform security principles or data categorization (for the PROTECT project).

Monitors programmatic systems and procedures to achieve and maintain optimal effectiveness of operational programs.
The Program Manager, In-Prison works to achieve continual improvement in customer service and outcomes.
Develops and approves recommendations for annual operational budgets in conjunction with appropriate administrators. Distributes resources appropriately to attain program goals.

Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with Company policies and applicable laws. The Program Manager, In-Prison maintains on-gong communication with customers to develop and enhance positive relationships and promote Company products and services.

Excellent oral and written communication skills.

GEO Reentry Services LLC.

GEO Reentry Services offers correctional agencies in-custody treatment programs for individuals nearing the end of their jail or prison sentences. You will drive program success by managing timelines, resolving cross-functional blockers, and maintaining a clear communication channel with enterprise customers as well as internal teams from a technical program management perspective. The ideal candidate thrives in fast-moving environments, communicates equally well with engineers and executives, and takes genuine ownership of outcomes.

Technical Team Interface

Build and maintain a Live Tracker of open items with Technical teams; share status with the Customer Decision Maker regularly, taking initiative to resolve with urgency and in support of end-customer objectives.
Coordinate badge and hardware troubleshooting and installation logistics with Customer Success and the Infrastructure Technical team.
Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success and Product to define and refine customer program KPIs, use cases and business case; validate feasibility and propose timelines based on input from Technical Teams.
Facilitate technical communications and requirements gathering between customers and Technical Teams.

Pilot Program Strategy & Planning

Support Product and Commercial teams in formulating comprehensive pilot scopes, defining KPIs, and establishing clear KPI measurement methodologies.
Develop and manage detailed project timelines that account for internal engineering development cycles, data operations needs, and external customer requirements and dependencies. This will be central to customer program management.

Program Management & Execution

Own the program timeline from kick-off to close; track milestones, dependencies, and blockers. Be the forcing function that ensures momentum and on-time delivery.
Manage lab and store install scheduling and coordination with the Infrastructure Technical Team and Customer Success.
Secure and organize all customer inputs required by Technical Teams; planograms, images, reference data, and other assets.
Initiate data collection workflows and manage associated dependencies.

Communication & Reporting

Own the weekly internal customer team meeting with Technical Team; set the agenda, drive decisions, and ensure follow-through on actions.
Ensure Sales and Customer Success have timely, accurate information from Technical Teams, and vice versa.
Own internal communication across Engineering, Product, and Customer/Commercial teams, acting as the primary source of truth for pilot status.
Use your Issue Tracker and Program Timeline track pilot program status, surface blockers, and communicate risks to stakeholders on a regular and consistent basis.
Serve as the primary technical point of contact for Customer Team on all matters related to technical planning and installation; liaise and involve internal technical teams for timely and accurate resolution.
Escalate blockers to the Customer Team Decision Maker when resolution requires prioritization or cross-Team collaboration.
Work closely with the Customer Team Decision Maker on a day-to-day basis to ensure priorities are accurately understood and communicated.

Experience & Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in a technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering) or equivalent practical experience.
3+ years of experience in technical program management, product management, or a similar role managing complex projects with internal and external stakeholders.
Proven ability to formulate project plans, manage complex timelines, and drive cross-functional teams to meet deadlines.
Exceptional communication skills; able to articulate technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences and translate customer requirements into actionable engineering tasks.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of identifying and resolving project blockers.
Experience supporting customer-facing teams and communicating directly with enterprise clients.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in retail technology, computer vision, or B2B SaaS.
Familiarity with agile methodologies and project management tools (e.g., Linear, Notion).
Understanding of the software development lifecycle, particularly in real-time or AI-driven systems.

reports.

retroactivity handling.

disenrollment procedures.

▪ Monitors enrollment files and reconciliation processes to ensure timely and accurate

Testing (UAT), and operational readiness (ORR) during implementation.

during implementation.

auditing, compliance monitoring, and performance reporting.

Description

CS Platform & Experience is responsible for defining the ideal support journey for guests and hosts, and developing the customer-facing and internal Community Support products and platforms that deliver world-class support. We partner across to integrate support into every product and service, and we are executing on an ambitious AI-native roadmap toward 10-star customer service.
A foundational piece of that roadmap is the AI Skills Repository — a governed library of AI-powered skills built on Claude that automate, accelerate, and standardize workflows across the team. This role owns that repository end to end.
The Role
We are looking for an AI Implementation Technical Program Manager to build and steward the CS AI Tools Repository. This is a new, high-impact role at the intersection of AI product operations, knowledge management, and quality assurance. You will partner with product managers, engineers, operations leads, and frontline teams to turn institutional knowledge into reusable, verified, production-grade AI tools and keep them accurate, current, and effective as our products and processes evolve.
You will own the full skills lifecycle: creation, verification, maintenance, and quality management. You will present creative ideas and prototypes of new skills to target audiences for feedback and implementation. You will define the standards and governance model for the repository, run evaluation frameworks to ensure AI tool quality, and serve as the authoritative voice on what "good" looks like for AI-assisted workflows in Community Support.

Duties

Partner with product managers, operations leads, and subject-matter experts across CS to identify high-value workflows suitable for AI tool development.
Coordinate and conduct the development, testing, and implementation of AI skills + tools for internal teams ensuring a high standard of output from each tool.
Define and steward the AI tools submission lifecycle including standardised templates, acceptance criteria, and governance across the end-to-end workflow
Design and operate a structured AI tool evaluation framework by defining test cases and pass/fail standards before any tool enters the repository.
Own the ongoing health of the repository: monitor for use cases that become stale, inaccurate, or redundant as products, CS policies, or operational workflows change.
Maintain a version history and changelog for every AI tool, enabling rollback and audit.
Establish clear deprecation criteria and processes by retiring tools that no longer deliver value while communicating changes to affected teams.
Define and own the CS AI tooling governance model: naming conventions, metadata standards, access controls, review cadences, and ownership assignment.
Create and maintain a skills catalogue that makes the repository discoverable and usable for all CS team members including clear documentation of purpose, inputs/outputs, limitations, and known edge cases for every skill.
Run regular repository audits, producing health reports that track coverage, quality scores, adoption trends, and outstanding gaps for leadership.
Champion responsible AI practices, ensuring skills include appropriate guardrails, escalation paths, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints where required.
Collaborate with the Chief of Staff to run team wide training sessions, produce newsletters and other communications ensuring alignment with the broader organization.

Requirements

7+ years of experience in technical program management with a proven track record of success.
Demonstrable experience working with AI tools, including prompt engineering, LLM-based product development, or AI workflow automation, with a strong instinct for where AI adds genuine value vs. where it introduces risk.
Exceptional written communication: the ability to translate complex operational workflows into clear, precise, structured documentation that non-technical readers can act on.
Experience designing and running quality or evaluation frameworks — you have a track record of defining what "good" looks like and holding work to that standard.
Strong program management instincts: you can manage a portfolio of work across multiple stakeholders, balance competing priorities, and deliver reliably.
A collaborative, ambitious, low-ego working style. This role requires influence without authority across product, engineering, operations, and analytics teams.
Hands-on, working knowledge of software product development life-cycle and methodologies. Specific experience with Agile is preferred.
Preferred
Experience in a customer support, trust, or operations organization at a technology company.
Understanding of data quality principles and experience working with analytics or data science teams to instrument impact metrics.

Our Culture

new_jobs.title: Senior Revenue Enablement Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
About Us:

ChowNow is one of the leading players in off-premise restaurant technology. As takeout becomes a vital revenue stream for independent restaurants, our platform helps owners focus on what they do best—serving great food—by offering solutions across the entire digital dining experience. From building branded websites and mobile apps, to powering online orders, managing menus, consolidating delivery, and running targeted marketing, we give restaurants the tools to grow on their own terms.

We support thousands of
 restaurants across North America
, helping process $1B+ in gross food sales
while saving our partners over $700M in third-party commission fees
. Through our white-label ordering solutions, a growing demand network (including Google, Yelp, Apple, and Snap), and a diner-friendly marketplace, we empower independent restaurants to own their customer relationships and avoid inflated pricing and fees charged by 3rd party delivery apps like Uber and Doordash. 

Founded in 2012, we’ve navigated rapid growth and transformation—from startup roots through the pandemic boom—and are now beginning an exciting new era under our CEO, Kanika Soni
. As we evolve with new leadership and cutting-edge tools, we’re deepening our commitment to helping local restaurants thrive in the digital economy.

About the Position:

We're looking for a strategic, AI and data-driven Senior Revenue Enablement Program Manager to accelerate the performance of our Revenue organization. The Enablement team sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, Marketing, and Revenue Operations and is responsible for driving AI strategy across revenue-facing teams. This is a hands-on role for someone who's excited about where AI can take us and has real-world experience using tools like Claude and GPT in their day-to-day workflow.

A core part of this role is using AI to close the gap between "we know what reps should be doing differently" and "reps are actually doing it." You'll be expected to identify specific productivity and skill gaps from call, pipeline, and performance data, then design AI-powered workflows — not just AI-assisted content — that put the right nudge, prompt, or resource in front of the right rep at the right moment in their selling motion. This is a build-and-operate mandate, not a research project: you're expected to ship workflows that measurably change rep behavior.

In addition, you will lead enablement initiatives including but not limited to: new product launches, pricing and packaging rollouts, everboarding programs, skills development, and process adoption. You won't just deliver training — you'll design scalable systems that improve execution quality, shorten sales cycles, increase win rates, and elevate seller confidence.

This is a highly cross-functional, high-visibility role for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, doesn’t let things slip through the cracks even though they are juggling multiple initiatives at once, knows how to influence senior stakeholders which includes our CEO, and can connect enablement efforts directly to business outcomes.

This position will report to our Director of Revenue Enablement. No direct reports.

This is a remote role based in the United States. Please note:
ChowNow is not eligible to employ in every state and the recruiting team will confirm location and eligibility before moving past initial stages.

WHAT WE LOVE ABOUT YOU:

You put restaurants first.
You deeply understand the importance of local restaurants and put them at the center of everything you do. You aim to help them not only survive but thrive.

You celebrate diversity.
You recognize that diversity and inclusivity matter. You’re committed to progress, which means everyone gets the support and resources they need, no matter who they are.  You have an ability to listen to other team members' ideas and can thrive in an environment that embraces individuality. Everyone’s voice counts.

You raise your hand.
You consistently go above and beyond what is asked of you. You help your peers accomplish their tasks while also excelling at accomplishing your own. When you have a smart idea, you raise your hand and share it.

You keep reaching.
You set clear ambitious goals. You don’t allow yourself to become complacent with where you’re at and what you’ve done, so you seek out new opportunities and challenges.

Responsibilities Include:

Diagnose Gaps & Design AI-Powered Rep Workflows

Mine call recordings, CRM data, pipeline metrics, and win/loss trends to pinpoint specific productivity gaps by rep, segment, or stage (e.g., weak discovery on a given package, slow follow-up after demo, inconsistent qualification)

Translate identified gaps into AI-powered workflows that intervene at the point of work — e.g., real-time call prompts, auto-generated next-best-action nudges, AI-drafted follow-up emails tailored to deal stage, or automated coaching flags routed to managers

Own the full loop: gap identification → workflow design → rollout → adoption measurement → iteration, so workflows keep pace with what the data is showing

Prioritize which gaps are worth building an AI workflow for vs. addressing through traditional training, based on rep time saved and expected impact on productivity metrics (activity volume, cycle time, win rate)

Drive Key Enablement Initiatives

Product Enablement: Lead end-to-end enablement strategy for new product, pricing, and positioning launches — partnering with Product Marketing to translate messaging into talk tracks, demo flows, competitive positioning, and launch certification programs with measurable adoption metrics (call behaviors, pipeline mix, win rate impact)

Skills & Everboarding Enablement: Design ongoing AE development programs across core selling motions, operationalizing skills frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC) into repeatable training with structured learning journeys tied to tenure and performance

Leadership Enablement: Build and deliver manager playbooks and coaching tools — for both first-time and tenured frontline managers — to inspect call quality, qualification depth, and deal strategy, supporting coaching cadences that drive measurable lift in win rates

Use AI tools (e.g., Gong AI, Claude, Notion AI, or similar) to accelerate production of talk tracks, battlecards, and certification content, and keep it current as messaging evolves

Measure Impact & Partner Strategically

Define success metrics for every initiative, tracking leading indicators (behavior change, certification completion, call quality) and lagging indicators (win rate, ACV, ramp time)

Quantify the productivity lift from each AI-powered workflow (time saved per rep, activity or output increase, downstream effect on pipeline/win rate) and use that data to decide what scales

Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales leadership, aligning enablement priorities to revenue goals and presenting impact insights to executives

Act as the internal champion for AI-driven productivity gains across the Revenue org — helping reps and managers adopt the workflows you build, not just the tools themselves

Within 30 days you'll...

Complete ChowNow New Hire Onboarding Experience 

Build strong relationships with Sales leadership, frontline managers, Product, Marketing, and RevOps

Audit existing AE enablement programs, onboarding, assets, certifications, and tooling

Review pipeline metrics, win/loss data, and call recordings to identify execution gaps

Identify top 3 performance levers impacting AE productivity — and flag which ones are candidates for an AI-powered workflow vs. traditional enablement

Get up to speed on ChowNow's current AI and call-intelligence tooling (e.g., Gong AI) and what's already been tried

Within 60 days you'll...

Roll out and measure at least one high-impact enablement initiative identified

Design and launch new AI-powered workflows targeting a specific identified gaps (e.g., an automated coaching flag, a next-best-action prompt, an AI-assisted follow-up workflow) and begin tracking the impact on rep productivity

Establish an ongoing AE everboarding calendar tied to performance data

Present early progress and insights to Sales leadership

Within 90 days you'll...

Achieve defined adoption metrics for at least one major initiative

Show a measurable productivity result from at least one AI-powered workflow (e.g., time saved per rep, increased activity, improved conversion at the targeted stage) and a plan to expand or retire it based on the data

Demonstrate early indicators of revenue impact (improved discovery quality, improved pipeline hygiene, increased attach rate, etc.)

Finalize and socialize a 6–12 month AE enablement strategy that includes a pipeline of future AI-powered workflows tied to ongoing gap analysis

You Should Apply If You Have:

6+ years of experience in Sales Enablement, Revenue Enablement, or Sales Performance roles supporting Account Executives or Account Managers in a SaaS or high-growth technology environment

A proven track record leading enablement programming lifecycles end to end

Deep understanding of SaaS sales cycles (especially SMB)

Demonstrated experience turning a diagnosed performance gap into an AI-powered workflow or tool that changed rep behavior at scale — not just using AI to draft content, but designing a system reps interact with in their day-to-day work

Comfort working hands-on with AI/automation tools (e.g., Gong AI, generative AI platforms, workflow automation tools) to prototype and ship these workflows without heavy engineering support

Experience operationalizing discovery and value frameworks into scalable programs (BANT, MEDDPICC, etc)

Strong data fluency — ability to tie enablement initiatives to measurable business impact (win rate, ACV, pipeline conversion, ramp time, etc.)

Experience partnering closely with Sales, Product Marketing, RevOps, and frontline Sales Managers

Experience supporting call coaching platforms (Gong) and embedding coaching frameworks into manager rhythms

Excellent executive communication skills; comfortable presenting to senior leadership

Strong organization skills and can lead multiple concurrent initiatives without losing quality or velocity

About Our Benefits:

Estimated Base Salary:
$130,000- $172,000 (depending on candidate location and experience)

Ongoing training and growth opportunities

A "Best Place to Work" winner multiple times where we focus on creating a great employee experience

Rock solid medical, dental, and vision plans

Mental Health Coverage - we offer several programs to support your mental health and wellness goals

Unlimited Paid Vacation. We expect you to work hard, but still enjoy your personal life

7 weeks of baby bonding time for all new parents (within the first year of birth or adoption), 8 Weeks of Paid Pregnancy Leave

401(k) Matching

Employer-contributing student loan assistance program or continuing education reimbursement program

Employee Stock Incentive Plan

Pet insurance for your fur babies

Consistent & fair leadership: we’ll share info, set clear goals, show you respect, and treat everyone fairly

Enough freedom to spread your wings while still holding you accountable

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

Job Overview:

Legal and Compliance manages all legal and regulatory matters, including privacy, contracts, corporate governance, compliance, employment law, intellectual property, government relations, and claims, while supporting Coursera's and Udemy's platforms and partnerships. The Privacy Program Manager is responsible for operationalizing and scaling the company's global privacy program across products, platforms, and business functions. Working closely with Legal, Security, Engineering, Product, Marketing, and other cross-functional partners, this role translates privacy and data protection requirements into scalable operational processes, governance, and technical controls that embed privacy by design across the organization. The role owns core privacy operations, including privacy impact assessments, records of processing activities, vendor privacy reviews, and data subject rights requests, while driving automation, self-service capabilities, and continuous improvement to enable the business to meet privacy obligations efficiently at scale.

Responsibilities:

Lead and continuously improve core privacy program operations, including privacy impact assessments (DPIAs), records of processing activities (ROPAs), vendor privacy reviews, and privacy compliance workflows, using privacy management tools and workflow automation where appropriate.
Design, implement, and manage scalable processes for data subject rights requests and general privacy inquiries, partnering with Engineering and Support teams to improve efficiency while meeting regulatory deadlines.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Marketing, Procurement, and other stakeholders to conduct privacy reviews for new products, features, vendors, and business initiatives, embedding privacy by design into business processes.
Develop and maintain privacy policies, standards, operational guidance, training, records, and self-service resources that enable teams to manage routine privacy obligations independently, with clear escalation paths where appropriate.
Monitor changes in global privacy laws and regulations, translating legal requirements into practical operational processes, controls, and guidance.
Define and report on privacy program metrics, identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, and support initiatives related to incident response, data retention, cross-border data transfers, and broader privacy governance.

Qualifications:

5+ years of experience in privacy, data protection, compliance, or a related program management function.
Demonstrated experience supporting a privacy program subject to the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and one or more U.S. state privacy laws, such as the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), within a multinational or complex organization.
Demonstrated experience translating privacy and data protection requirements, including GDPR and CCPA, into operational processes, policies, controls, guidance, or technical requirements in partnership with Legal, Engineering, Product, and Security teams.
Experience conducting operational privacy activities, including DPIAs, maintaining ROPAs, managing data subject rights requests, vendor privacy reviews, privacy due diligence, and privacy contract reviews.
Experience implementing, administering, or optimizing a privacy management platform (such as OneTrust, TrustArc, or a comparable solution) to support privacy operations, workflow automation, and program governance.
Bachelor's degree (or equivalent practical experience) and a Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP), Certified Information Privacy Manager (CIPM), Certified Information Privacy Technologist (CIPT), or equivalent privacy certification.

Nice to haves:

Experience working in a technology, software-as-a-service (SaaS), or online education environment.
Experience supporting privacy programs for artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning products.
Experience supporting compliance with additional global privacy laws, including APAC and Latin American privacy frameworks.
Experience defining and reporting operational metrics, KPIs, or dashboards for privacy programs.
Law degree or equivalent legal training.

Who You’ll Work With
At Slalom, our Delivery capability is the engine that powers transformation. We are the connective tissue across all capabilities—bringing strategy to life through execution that is rigorous, adaptive, and outcome-driven.
You’ll join a community of delivery professionals who thrive in complexity and are passionate about making things happen. Our teams lead high-impact initiatives across industries, partnering with clients to navigate ambiguity, align stakeholders, and deliver results that matter. Whether it’s a multi-workstream transformation or a product launch, we bring clarity, structure, and momentum to every engagement.
We work shoulder-to-shoulder with clients, tailoring delivery approaches to meet them where they are—whether Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid. Our focus is on enabling predictable, repeatable outcomes that help organizations dream bigger, move faster, and build better tomorrows.

Mission Technologies’ Global Security (GS) group comprises live, virtual, constructive (LVC) solutions; fleet sustainment; nuclear and environmental; and Australia business.

As a trusted partner to our military customers, HII designs, develops and operates the largest LVC enterprise that prepares warfighters for cross-domain battle. With advanced technologies to enable mission readiness, HII understands that preparation requires full coordination—not readiness in piece-parts.

For more than 40 years, the U.S. Navy has entrusted HII to maintain and modernize the vast majority of its fleet. With a holistic approach to life-cycle maritime defense systems—from small watercraft to submarines, surface combatants and aircraft carriers—HII ensures a high state of readiness.

HII supports the Department of Energy’s national security mission through the management and operation of its sites, as well as the safe cleanup of legacy waste across the country. HII meets clients’ toughest nuclear and environmental challenges.

Leadership Mindset at HII – Mission Technologies

Role

Leadership at HII is a mindset, not a title. Through our Leadership Capability Framework, we define how every employee grows, leads, and contributes—regardless of role. It sets the standard for how you can develop yourself and what you can expect from leaders across our organization. We look for candidates who want to grow in alignment with these capabilities:

Know & Grow Your People – Commit to learning and supporting team success.
Build Relationships – Communicate openly, collaborate well, and build trust.
Take Ownership – Deliver on commitments and take pride in your work.
Customer First – Focus on the mission and those we serve.
Shape the Future – Bring ideas, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
Act with Urgency – Take initiative and follow through with purpose.

These capabilities guide how all employees contribute to our shared success across Mission Technologies.

Summary

Mission Technologies, a division of Huntington Ingalls Industries, is looking for a Program Manager 3 for the Joint Training Synthetic Environment (JTSE) Research and Development (R&D) program in support of the Joint Staff (JS) J7 Deputy Director Joint Training and Exercises (DDJTE).

Background

JS J7 DDJTE provides Joint capability, material development, and maintenance support to the Joint training environment supporting all elements of the Joint Force. The JS J7 DDJTE primarily supports the Joint Training Enterprise (JTE) with common integrated force development capabilities enabling Joint training.

The objective of this Task Order is to research, analyze, and develop capabilities to provide warfighters with a JTSE nested with evolving modernization efforts within the program. The JTSE is one of the critical enablers that support the delivery of trained, capable, and interoperable Joint Forces. There are three primary product lines supported by the program: the Joint, Live, Virtual, Constructive (JLVC) Federation, the Joint Training Tool (JTT), and the Joint Lessons Learned Information System (JLLIS). The JTSE Program provides management and development expertise to the JS J7 DDJTE by modernizing and sustaining the JLVC Federation, developing JTT, and maintaining JLLIS.

Establish milestones and monitor adherence to program’s plan and schedule.
Identify issues and develop solutions, such as allocation of resources or changes to program milestones.
Develop program review sessions with the government customer to discuss cost, schedule, resourcing, and technical performance.
Manage and coordinate subcontract efforts, and monitor, measure, report, and control cost and schedule metrics.
Act as one of the government customer’s contacts for program activities.
Meet regularly with and update the government customer on project statuses within the program.

new_jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Prime Video
new_jobs.description:
Description

Prime Video (PV) is seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager (TPM) to own Operational Excellence and Development Efficiency across the business. Reporting directly to the Director of READI, this is a strategic, single-threaded leadership role for a builder who thrives in ambiguity and can set direction where the problem itself is not yet defined.

As a Principal TPM, you will operate across VP organizations, exercising broad strategic influence over how Prime Video plans, measures, and improves the operational health of its services and the productivity of its engineers. You will own high-visibility operating mechanisms — most notably the Prime Video Quarterly Operations Review — and set the overall strategy, goals, and initiatives for Operational Excellence across PV. You will manage significantly complex, cross-functional initiatives, remediate endemic problems, and force-multiply your impact through the mechanisms and standards you create. This is a role for someone who is regularly escalated to, rather than one who escalates.

Key job responsibilities

Operational Excellence Strategy & Goals

Define and own the multi-year strategy, annual goals, and initiative portfolio for Operational Excellence across Prime Video, aligning teams and organizations toward a simple, coherent approach.

Establish the operational metrics, standards, and paved-road practices that define what “good” looks like for PV services — covering availability, resilience, incident management, and operational readiness.

Set and track org-level operational goals planning, translating leadership priorities into measurable outcomes and holding teams accountable to them.

Remediate critical and endemic operational problems by identifying systemic root causes and driving durable, cross-org fixes rather than point solutions.

High-Visibility Mechanisms (PV Quarterly Operations Review)

Own the Prime Video Quarterly Operations Review end-to-end — its agenda, data, narrative, and follow-through — as the authoritative forum where PV leadership inspects operational health and commits to improvements.

Design, run, and continuously improve the portfolio of operating mechanisms (weekly/monthly business and ops reviews, metrics dashboards, and governance cadences) that create predictable inspection and drive action.

Curate crisp, accurate, and timely written narratives and data for senior leaders (up to and including VPs and S-Team-facing readouts), ensuring decisions are well-informed and action items are tracked to closure.

Create the connective tissue between mechanisms so that signals surfaced in one forum reliably drive prioritization, resourcing, and roadmap decisions across PV.

Development Efficiency

Own the strategy for improving developer productivity and delivery velocity across PV — reducing friction in the software lifecycle from design through deployment and operations.

Define and instrument developer efficiency metrics (e.g., build and deployment health, cycle time, change failure rate, time-to-recover) and use them to target the highest-leverage investments.

Drive adoption of paved-road tooling, standards, and best practices that simplify how PV teams build and operate, eliminating undifferentiated heavy lifting and unnecessary process.

Partner with builder-tools and infrastructure teams to unblock innovation and increase the speed and safety of delivery at scale.

Cross-Org Influence & Force Multiplication

Operate across VP organizations with broad strategic influence, building consensus, securing commitments, and negotiating positive outcomes among senior engineering and product leaders.

Drive clarity in ambiguity — frame problems that are not yet defined, align stakeholders on the path forward, and deliver with complete independence.

Force-multiply through the mechanisms, standards, and structures you create, raising the operational bar across teams without being in the critical path of every decision.

Actively develop the TPM community at PV — mentoring senior TPMs, contributing to promotion assessments, and elevating program-management craft across the organization.

A day in the life

No two days look the same, but the through-line is mechanism ownership and strategic influence. You might begin the morning diving deep into operational metrics ahead of the Quarterly Operations Review — pressure-testing the data, sharpening the narrative, and pre-aligning VP-org leaders on the decisions that need to be made. Midday, you facilitate a working session with engineering directors to unblock a cross-org resilience initiative, making the trade-off calls between business opportunity, resources, and long-term sustainability.

In the afternoon, you shift to development efficiency — reviewing delivery-velocity trends, identifying the systemic bottlenecks slowing teams down, and shaping the paved-road investments that will remove them. Throughout, you are the person leaders are escalated to when operational health is at risk, and the owner who ensures every commitment coming out of a mechanism is tracked to closure. Your success is measured not by the work you personally execute, but by the durable systems, standards, and mechanisms you leave behind.

About The Team

READI is a central function in Prime Video that drives strategy, tooling, and programs for Scale Readiness, Operational Excellence, Resilience & Observability, and Development Efficiency. READI’s value as a central team relies heavily on outward-facing influence: its strategy, decisions, and guidance are amplified across all of PV. Prime Video operates a global, high-scale streaming service, spending hundreds of millions in infrastructure and allocating hundreds of engineers to operational load each year — a surface area where disciplined operational rigor and improved development efficiency translate directly into customer experience, cost, and speed of innovation.

Today, ownership of PV-wide Operational Excellence strategy and its supporting mechanisms is distributed, creating diffusion of responsibility and inconsistent standards across teams. This role exists to close that gap: to be the single-threaded owner who defines what operational excellence means for PV, instruments it, runs the mechanisms that inspect it, and drives the initiatives that continuously raise the bar.

Basic Qualifications

12+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
10+ years of technical product or program management experience
5+ years of software development experience
Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

new_jobs.description:
Description

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

Prime Video is on a mission to reimagine how customers discover and engage with content across the entertainment landscape. As part of this vision, we’re investing heavily in building scalable, science-friendly infrastructure to accelerate the pace of innovation in machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI). We’re seeking a Principal Engineer to lead the technical direction of our next-generation Recommender Systems (RecSys) platforms — systems that sit at the core of how customers experience Prime Video.

About The Team

Prime Video Personalization and Discovery (PVPD) is dedicated to creating a highly personalized content discovery experience that not only delights our customers but also drives both short-and long-term business goals. Our scope includes personalized recommendations, search, marketing, and the advanced machine learning technology and infrastructure that underpins these experiences. Our mission is to automate and enhance customer engagement through personalization, using ML and Generative AI.

Key Job Responsibilities

In this role, you will partner closely with applied scientists, product teams, and platform engineers to define and deliver highly extensible systems that fuel personalized discovery at scale. you will lead the technical strategy and architecture of Prime Video’s end-to-end personalization stack — spanning data ingestion, feature engineering, training and serving platform, candidate retrieval, multi-stage ranking, dynamic content grouping, whole page optimization, and orchestration. Your work will shape how millions of customers discover content they love, optimizing for engagement, retention, and long-term customer value.

You will bring clarity to ambiguity, complexity, ROI, planning, and trade-off etc that dramatically improves the agility, usability, and extensibility of our ML solutions. Your technical leadership will shape the future of AI/ML across Prime Video, unlocking generative and ML models that personalize content for hundreds of millions of viewers worldwide.

Key job responsibilities

Consistently meet challenging deadlines and deliver high-quality solutions that enable the Prime Video platform to scale to meet growing customer demand.
Overcome obstacles and persist in the face of setbacks to ensure critical initiatives are successfully completed.

Demonstrate deep technical expertise in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, ML/AI fluency and large-scale data processing.

Use data-driven analysis to make a compelling case for project priorities and resource allocation.
Accountable for the overall strategy and successful execution of large, complex infrastructure optimization and scaling programs.
Partner closely with engineering, product, and business leaders to align initiatives with high-level objectives and achieve measurable improvements in efficiency or customer experience.
Communicate ideas effectively to a wide range of audiences, foster constructive dialogue, and lead the resolution of contentious technical issues.
Set a best-in-class example for project/program management practices, driving crisp decision-making and proactive risk mitigation.

Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Earth Observation
new_jobs.description:
About The Role

Muon seeks a Senior Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead earth observation programs for U.S. Government customers. This is a high-visibility, high-impact role at the intersection of payload engineering and rapid-cycle space vehicle development. These programs span the full mission lifecycle — concept development and design through integration, launch, and on-orbit operations — and are executed under formal government contract structures with defined deliverables and milestones. The Senior TPM runs the program end to end: executing every contractual commitment and positioning Muon to win the work that follows.

The Senior TPM holds single-point accountability for delivering the program on schedule, within budget, and to technical performance standards. Operating with high autonomy on an accelerated contractual schedule, you will drive key milestones and lead cross-functional technical exchanges spanning systems engineering, payload, flight software, ground segment, and mission operations.

This position is hybrid and requires working on-site in our San Jose, CA office three days per week.

Responsibilities

Program Execution

Serve as the single accountable owner for the program's cost, schedule, and technical baselines
Own the integrated master schedule, cost baseline, and risk register; track and report progress against contract milestones
Plan and run formal program events — internal readiness reviews, and customer-facing milestone deliverable reviews
Maintain tight cost and schedule discipline; surface deviations to the customer promptly and with a recovery plan

Customer Interface

Act as the primary programmatic interface to the Government customer, including contracting and technical representatives
Lead technical exchange meetings and convert customer input into actionable program direction
Own the delivery and quality of all contract data deliverables

Cross-Functional Leadership

Direct a cross-functional team spanning systems engineering, payload, flight software, ground processing, and mission operations
Partner with mission operations when program activities involve Muon's operational systems — without disrupting existing missions
Drive design trades and study conclusions to closure on schedule, escalating crisply when decisions stall

Security, Compliance, and Growth

Execute the program in full compliance with its government security requirements, including handling of controlled information and strict public-release restrictions
Ensure compliance with ITAR/EAR export controls and U.S.-only performance requirements
Support program growth: convert program artifacts into proposal-ready material and support capture of follow-on opportunities

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in engineering or a technical field, or equivalent experience.
8+ years of program management experience on complex aerospace or defense development programs, including direct ownership of cost, schedule, and technical baselines
Experience executing U.S. Government contracts: statement-of-work and CDRL deliverables, milestone-based structures, and day-to-day work with government contracting and technical representatives
Experience leading engineering teams through concept development, trade studies, and preliminary design
Exceptional written communication skills — you will author and own the quality of customer-facing reports, design artifacts, and contract deliverables

Preferred Qualifications

Satellite or instrument program leadership across the full lifecycle (design, build,
integrate, test, operate)
Domain experience with remote sensing systems — EO/IR, RF, or both — at the payload or mission level
Direct experience working with USSF Space Systems Command or JPL
PMP certification or equivalent program management credentials
Ability to obtain a security clearance

Salary

The salary range for this role is $206,000 - $232,000, plus a competitive equity grant and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and geographic location as assessed during the interview process.

About Muon Space

Founded in 2021, Muon Space is an end-to-end Space Systems Provider that designs, builds, and operates LEO satellite constellations delivering mission-critical data. Our revolutionary, integrated technology stack enables customers to optimize every dimension of their missions for faster time-to-orbit and superior constellation remote sensing performance. Our state-of-the-art facility in the heart of Silicon Valley is optimized for manufacturing spacecraft and rapid, flexible payload integration at scale. From climate monitoring to national security, Muon Space is dedicated to delivering Earth Intelligence for a safer and more resilient world.

Taking Care of Our Team

At Muon salary is only part of our total compensation package. In addition to salary, full-time employees receive equity compensation as well as benefits including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401k retirement plan, short & long term disability and life insurance. We also offer three weeks paid vacation for new employees, along with 12 paid holidays, unlimited sick time and paid parental leave.

Our mission embraces the entire planet and we believe our team should too. Muon is dedicated to creating a diverse and dynamic company and workforce. We believe in equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, age, national origin, citizenship, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or gender identity. We value diversity in the workplace, and that starts with our applicants. We encourage you to apply, even if you don't check all the boxes, and we look forward to reviewing your application! In addition, if you need a reasonable accommodation as part of your application for employment or interviews with us, please let us know.

ITAR/EAR Requirements

This position requires access to export controlled information. To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful, permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C.

1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C.
1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency. The Company may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.

new_jobs.description:
At Nord Quantique, we strive to build impactful technology by relentlessly pushing our understanding of quantum science. We are an interdisciplinary team of scientists, engineers, innovators, builders, and enthusiasts on a mission to make quantum computing a reality. Our quantum processors are designed to reduce errors in quantum computation to facilitate long-term scaling toward fully-fledged quantum computers. We believe it is our responsibility to deliver this transformative technology for the greater good of society.

Located at the heart of the beautiful Eastern Townships region in the province of Quebec, Canada, we develop our technology in the vibrant quantum ecosystem of Sherbrooke. Leaning on more than a decade of vertical integration of quantum hardware, we are leveraging a comprehensive pool of quantum technology and micro-electronic infrastructure to deploy our quantum computing technology.

Our current needs

Nord Quantique is building its Project Management Office (PMO) to support and scale the execution of its scientific roadmap in a context of growing R&D complexity.

As a Project Manager within this function, you will work under the guidance of the Head of PMO and play a key role in coordinating and supporting the execution of R&D projects across the organization.

You will act as a strategic operational partner to technical and team leads, helping bring clarity, alignment, and structure to fast-moving and evolving research programs. Through hands-on involvement in day-to-day coordination, you will ensure that priorities, dependencies, and milestones remain visible, aligned, and actionable, while facilitating communication across interdisciplinary teams.

In an initial phase, you will work closely with multiple R&D teams to coordinate priorities, track progress, identify bottlenecks, and support execution. This phase is critical for developing a deep understanding of team workflows, building strong working relationships, and ensuring consistency in project coordination practices.

As the PMO matures, your role will progressively evolve toward increased ownership of project coordination activities and active contribution to the implementation and continuous improvement of project management practices, tools, and processes tailored to an exploratory R&D environment where priorities evolve and uncertainty is inherent.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys operating at the intersection of science, engineering, and operations, who thrives in dynamic and complex environments, and who is motivated by enabling technical teams to do their best work by bringing structure without rigidity.

Working in close collaboration with technical and management staff at Nord Quantique, the chosen candidate will:

Coordinate project timelines, deliverables, and internal milestones across R&D teams
Maintain clarity on priorities, dependencies, and overall project status
Support technical leads in planning, resource coordination, and milestone definition
Facilitate cross-team communication and ensure alignment across projects
Maintain up-to-date project documentation and tracking tools
Identify execution bottlenecks and support resolution of operational challenges
Support day-to-day execution through structured follow-ups and coordination
Ensure alignment with PMO guidelines, processes, and standards
Apply and maintain structured reporting processes, providing clear and consistent updates
Contribute to continuous improvement of PMO practices, tools, and workflows, while supporting a positive and collaborative team environment

Required

Education and experience requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, physics, or a related field
Minimum of 3 years of experience in project coordination or project management.
Experience supporting technical, scientific, or engineering teams.

Preferred

Experience contributing to process or workflow improvements.
Experience in deep-tech, quantum, or advanced R&D environments
Familiarity with project-management frameworks (agile, hybrid, or research-adapted) and tools (Ms Project, Jira, ClickUp, Notion, etc.)

Sought Expertise And Knowledge

Ability to enable change management activities within growing teams
Intermediate or higher level of French is an asset

Sought Profile

Organized and reliable, with a proactive approach to execution
Collaborative and empathetic, with an interest in team wellbeing
Ability to prioritize tasks and coordinate multiple cross-functional team projectsExcellent adaptability
Ability to bring structure to ambiguity
Skilled at building strong working relationships across technical and non-technical teams
Motivated by supporting innovation and enabling people to focus on what they do best

Nord Quantique is committed to the principles of equity, diversity, and inclusion in its training, workplaces, and activities. We encourage applications from diverse backgrounds and traditionally marginalized groups.

Our interdisciplinary team is laser-focused on solving grand challenges and making quantum computing a reality.

Nord Quantique is an equal-opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive work environment where all individuals can fulfill their aspirations while being supported and heard. new_jobs.title: Sr Technical Program Manager, Proactive Security (Level 6)
new_jobs.description:
Description

Cryptographically relevant quantum computers could break the classical cryptography that protects the confidentiality and integrity of Amazon customers' data. As the industry accelerates its post-quantum cryptography (PQC) readiness timelines, Specialized Business Security (SBS) must reason about and migrate an unusually diverse portfolio: devices already in customers' homes, future devices, protected content on third-party devices, and customer traffic across satellite and ground infrastructure. As Technical Program Manager for the SBS-wide PQProgram, you will own the cross-cutting PQC problems shared across teams and turn a fast-evolving, ambiguous space into clear tracked plans, and measurable readiness outcomes.

Key job responsibilities

Own the end-to-end PQC journey for shared crypto problems: code signing, PKI infrastructure, Crypto Bill of Materials (CBOM), and PQC migration of backend services.
Coordinate PQC work across Amazon organizations, importing and exporting reusable techniques and artifacts so related hardware and software efforts build on each other rather than in isolation.
Enumerate PQC readiness across device-relevant industry standards (Matter, Bluetooth, OAuth 2.0, DRM), clarify each standard's trajectory, and drive informed next steps with product and security teams.
Define program strategy, objectives, and success metrics; align stakeholders; and drive delivery across engineering teams while navigating crypto trade-offs, including device form-factor constraints (limited RAM/ROM/CPU).
Run recurring program business reviews, proactively identify and mitigate risk, and write and present narratives to senior leadership.

A day in the life

You review PQProgram metrics, then facilitate a design discussion on PQC migration for a constrained device, weighing algorithm options against RAM/ROM/CPU limits. You join a cross-organization working session to reuse a PQC approach already solved elsewhere in Amazon, draft a section of an upcoming leadership review, and update the standards tracker. Some days you drive execution on a well-defined problem; others you convert genuine ambiguity into a plan the org can follow.

About The Team

SBS Core secures a diverse set of Amazon businesses, working backwards from what products need to be secure. The SBS-wide PQProgram coordinates and executes the post-quantum cryptography work shared across these businesses. We value clear thinking, learning quickly in an evolving field, and taking ownership of hard, ambiguous problems that grow more important as the quantum timeline accelerates.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
5+ years of technical product or program management experience
3+ years of software development experience
5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
Familiarity with PQC migration guidance and timelines (e.g., CNSA 2.0, NIST PQC).

Strong background in research, development, and maturation of emerging technologies, including transitioning lower‑ and mid‑TRL capabilities toward operational readiness.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) Infrastructure Physical Security is seeking a highly talented and motivated Security Program Manager to join our team. The role is responsible for overseeing physical security design and the installation of security features and systems including access control, intrusion detection, camera surveillance, passive and active barriers, and other security features and capabilities consistent with AWS security standards and public sector contract requirements.
